# PDF Vector

PDF Vector parses documents into markdown, extracts structured data, answers document questions, and searches academic publications and grants.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/pdf-vector/.

## Actions

- **Ask Document** (read-only): Answer one question from a general, identity, invoice, or bank-statement document.
- **Extract Document Data** (read-only): Extract schema-constrained structured data from a general, identity, invoice, or bank-statement document.
- **Fetch Publications** (read-only): Resolve up to 100 publication identifiers with provider auto-detection and return both resolved records and per-identifier errors.
- **Find Citations** (read-only): Find relevant academic citations for each sentence in a paragraph and preserve provider-specific partial errors.
- **Find Similar Papers** (read-only): Find papers related to a seed publication using citation-network similarity, optionally including relationship edges.
- **Get Paper Graph** (read-only): Retrieve a publication plus one independently offset-controlled page of citing papers and one page of referenced papers.
- **Parse Academic Paper** (read-only): Resolve an academic identifier or provider URL to a public PDF and parse it to markdown.
- **Parse Document** (read-only): Convert a general, identity, invoice, or bank-statement document to markdown.
- **Search Publications** (read-only): Search academic publications across selected databases and return one offset-controlled page, including any provider-specific partial…
- **Search Research Grants** (read-only): Search US, EU, and UK research-grant providers and return one explicit offset-controlled page with partial provider errors.
